title: Synthetic dreaming for state-conditioned epistemic exploration in neural networks

sections.title: 研究问题
sections.text:
《Synthetic dreaming for state-conditioned epistemic exploration in neural networks》：研究问题的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-3】This work formalizes synthetic dreaming within a probabilistic framework using a hybrid training objective that combines empirical data with internally generated samples through a regulated dream-weight coefficient λ and a high-level latent variable h.

sections.title: 研究方法
sections.text:
《Synthetic dreaming for state-conditioned epistemic exploration in neural networks》：方法与研究设计的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-2】Inspired by biological dreaming, we propose a learning framework termed synthetic dreaming, in which a neural network generates internally imagined training samples conditioned on its evolving latent representations and integrates them into the optimization process.

【Abstract · abstract-1-3】This work formalizes synthetic dreaming within a probabilistic framework using a hybrid training objective that combines empirical data with internally generated samples through a regulated dream-weight coefficient λ and a high-level latent variable h.
